scope: Product-model create/edit forms integrate category attribute values inline (Magento-style): selecting a category renders that category's attribute definitions as typed inputs in the same form and saves them atomically with the model

businessFlow.subject: Admin catalog product-model create/edit flow renders the selected category's attribute fields inline and saves them with the model; category change clears values and warns

notes: The product-model create and edit forms now expose the selected category's attribute definitions as inline typed inputs (NUMBER/BOOLEAN/JSON/TEXT), matching Magento's product-form attribute pattern instead of a separate specifications page. Create: POST product model then PUT specifications (bulk setModelValues); a required attribute left empty is rejected client-side ("Missing required attributes: …") before creation, and server-side atomically via assertRequiredSpecificationValues. Edit: existing values are pre-filled; changing the category clears the values, shows a warning, and swaps to the new category's definitions. Verified headed end-to-end: selecting GPU rendered VRAM (GB)·required; an empty submit was blocked; filling 12 created the model with vram_gb=12 persisted (confirmed in DB); the edit modal pre-filled VRAM=12; changing to Laptop cleared it and swapped to Screen Size (in)·required. No new console errors (only the pre-existing unauthenticated /api/v1/me 401s).
